title: Tour with Mariana
text: We were lucky enough to spend the day with Mariana on a bike tour and it was amazing! She was so beyond lovely and knowledgeable and showed us all around where we wanted to do! Would definitely recommend her!
author: brookepQ6136MN

title: Biking Barcelona
text: What a great day out. I recommend this experience to anyone that wants to experience the real Barcelona. Marianna was great and shared her knowledge and passion for her city. Was a real highlight. A must do.
author: Jude C

title: Fun on a Bike
text: Fabulous day out. Recommend to all. Great way to see the real Barcelona and enjoy a authentic experience
author: Jude C

title: Fun on a bike
text: We did this our first day in Barcelona. What a fabulous experience, you get to see and hear about the real Barcelona.  Mariana is a fantastic guide and willing to share her knowledge. With great tips on how to experience the real city. Highly recommended
author: Jude C

title: True Local Tour by a Genuinely Knowledgeable and Passionate Guide
text: My wife and I had a lovely bike tour and all-encompassing local experience with Mariana at Be Like Us Tours.  Her knowledge and passion for Barcelona was genuine and infectious.  We really appreciated her insight and experience, and felt like we got more from this tour than we ever expected.  Our flight was delayed, so we missed our original booking, but she was kind enough to reschedule a bike tour a different day in her off-time (yea, WOW, Above and Beyond!).  Thank You Mariana, we will remember our tour, your kindness and the city fondly.
author: rt5

title: Outstanding Bike Experience
text: Mariana was our tour guide and she was a joy to spend the day with.  Prior to getting started on the bikes, Mariana inquired what we had done in the city up to that point to make a more personal day for us.  She is passionate about the city and made a memorable experience for us that continued after the bike tour finished.  Mariana graciously made reservations for us at a jazz bar in the gothic quarter at a restaurant, the owner had a table front and center waiting for us, it was a great day all around! Thanks Mariana
author: Jeffrey_M

title: Best 4 hour cycling trip 🥵
text:
This was the best way to view the best parts of Barcelona in my opinion 🥳👏🏽. Thank you to our amazing tour guide Marianna, she knows Barcelona like the back of her hand, she is patient, kind and energetic. I almost died twice trying to cycle up those hills 🤣 but she made sure no man is left behind. 
This was truly the best way to best 4 hours viewing Barcelona 😍.
author: lorittas2024

title: Worth it
text: I highly recommend this, our guide is so passionate about the tours, she did such an excellent job ensuring we got the most out of this exciting bike tour. We got to see the city from a local perspectives, the rich history behind the different monuments. It was such a lovely time. Safe, affordable and value for our money.
author: Road41376772511

title: The best way to experience Barcelona
text:
'Be like us' was recommended to us by a friend for the outstanding tour guide Mariana, who brings the whole trip to life, with joy and heart and lots of very interesting information. It is very clear that she loves Barcelona and is very able to spread her love and enthusiasm for this city. The service is so easy going. Mariana wants to make this a personal experience,what you want, you shall get out of it 
We loved it.
author: T4785YKsr

title: The perfect way to see Barcelona
text: A perfect way to see Barcelona. We saw the small streets, the tourist sites and learned a lot from our guide. The trip can easily be adjusted to your own wishes
